name: craft-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the creative-build studio in one install — concept-first creative direction with a tiered motion catalog (craft-layer), visual decisions rendered with the project's own components (design-preview), a shadcn staging sandbox (shadcn-studio), and live component-registry MCP sourcing (registry-source) — WebGL/Three.js effects now ship inside craft-layer — plus the companion the studio requires: ui-ux, which carries the WCAG audit. Split out of frontend-suite so ordinary frontend app work does not pay the studio's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /craft-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins. 200k-window installs: see the README's context-window requirement first.
